successCriteriaChoices: Go to the gym at least 3x per week
Don't skip two planned sessions in a row
Feel recovered, not wrecked, the next morning

selectedHabits: Go straight home after work instead of the gym
Decide whether to train after sitting down at home
Eat dinner before deciding on training
Leave gym bag in the car
No fixed pre-workout snack or fueling routine
environmentalCues: Gym is out of the way from the direct route home
Work laptop stays open into the evening
Couch and TV are the first thing seen at home
Kitchen is the first stop when hungry after work
failurePoints: Decides to skip once sitting on the couch
Overtime or late meetings running past planned leave time
Trains on an empty stomach or skips training because too hungry
Eats a full dinner right after arriving home, discouraging training afterward
intakeData.customNotes: Weekends have more free time but no fixed schedule at all.
